description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-13 (page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.146.html, change 2). Builds on top of fz-sc8.127's commit (OptionParser sends the hash); both edit src/compiler2/jobs/transport.rs.

Today evaluate_transport_recipe returns the first child that is not ready (jobs/transport.rs ~1062, ~1083), so a tuple or alternatives recipe with several unready children discovers them one driver round at a time. Every transport wait list in the distiller trace has exactly one entry (8,700 rounds, 8,700 waits).

Change: RecipeLayout::Waiting carries every unready child; Tuple and Alternatives collect them. The first-waiting return goes away entirely. Scratch patch: ts146/cfT_transport_rs.patch (also contains the .127 spike's 4-line transport.rs hunk; in the spike's Tuple arm a cut seen before a wait returns the wait, which the build must decide deliberately).

Measured on the .127 spike: distiller 53,684 -> 52,352 requests, keys 34,327 and jobs 11,604 unchanged; two/sharedL_8/splitL_8 interp output byte-identical; fixture_matrix 3119/0. One work pin falls: product_drive_test native_root_product_is_lowered_once_and_reused_by_exact_identity 54 -> 50 evaluations (lower and list).

Done when: a test observes request telemetry showing a recipe with three unready children costs its owner two pulls; the distiller request count is re-measured at the landing commit; full gate green; all three paths.
title: A transport recipe lists every unready child in one round
